audit.framework_rationale: TensorCircuit FGSSimulator performs the core state evolution, normalization, and correlation computation. NumPy constructs generators; JAX supplies differentiation and loops; Optax supplies Adam. No other quantum framework is imported in the submission. The evolution and QR behavior are supported by [TensorCircuit source](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tencent-quantum-lab/tensorcircuit/master/tensorcircuit/fgs.py).
audit.cheating_rationale: No hardcoded results, hidden data access, evaluator manipulation, or test/reward tampering appears. The Gaussian representation is an exact framework-supported simulation of this circuit.
audit.fidelity_rationale: The Hadamard-basis fermionic mapping correctly represents the initial plus state, X filters, alternating nearest-neighbor ZZ filters, and open-boundary Hamiltonian. Generator signs and factors produce the specified exponential strengths. Differentiable QR after each layer represents normalization of the many-body state. All configuration values are consumed, Adam performs exactly max_steps updates, history contains pre-update energies, and the returned NumPy arrays have the required layout.
audit.implementation_error_rationale: No obvious error identified. Passing an imaginary-scaled generator to evol_hamiltonian produces the intended non-unitary frame evolution; the subsequent imaginary-time operation normalizes the combined layer. Energy signs, parameter ordering, and history timing are consistent.
